rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Houtini LM is an MCP server that provides expert prompt engineering capabilities through LM Studio integration, featuring 35+ specialized functions for code analysis, generation, and creative tasks. Built with TypeScript and a modern plugin architecture, it offers intelligent context window management with automatic chunking for large codebases, comprehensive security validation with path traversal protection, and caching for performance optimization. The implementation includes analysis functions for code quality, security audits, and project structure evaluation, generation tools for unit tests, documentation, and WordPress themes, plus creative functions for games and CSS art generation. Designed for developers working with local AI models who need reliable, secure access to advanced prompting capabilities without cloud dependencies, it enables use cases like automated code review, documentation generation, security analysis, and rapid prototyping through Claude Desktop integration.
